game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Parenthesis Puzzle: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the ember furnace.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the ember furnace. Each round, molten golems strike the ember furnace, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the puzzle_gap value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the ember furnace from molten golems in Pumice Pass: keep the puzzle_gap meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: puzzle_gap drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Parenthesis Puzzle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how puzzle_gap changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 76 seconds while puzzle_gap > 0.
